description: This PHP source file is a controller class for the Customer Order report in the OpenCart admin panel. It handles rendering the report interface, saving report settings, and generating report data.

classes.name: CustomerOrder
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Customer Order report in OpenCart admin. Provides methods to display, save settings, and render report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes and displays the customer order report page, sets up breadcrumbs and includes necessary controllers.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report configuration settings via POST request and returns JSON result.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer order report details.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list view of the customer order report.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the customer order report data in view format, handling filtering, pagination, and data retrieval.
